Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 2473 of 2025
Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Mittal
Opposite Party :- Drug Inspector Agra Food Safety And Drug Administration
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Yadav

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1. Heard Sri Ajay Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri S.P. Singh, learned State Law Officer for the State.

2. Thous this is an application under Section 528 of BNSS preferred by the applicant for quashing the summoning order dated 02.02.2024 passed by the Court of learned Special Judge (N.D.P.S.
Act)/Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.26, Agra as well as proceedings of Complaint No.265 of 2024 (State Vs. Manoj Kumar Mittal), Under Section 8(c), 27, 18a(i), 18A, 18B, 27(d), 28A of Drugs and Cosmetics Act, Police Station-Kamalnagar, District Agra, pending in the Court of learned Special Judge (N.D.P.S. Act)/Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.26, Agra,, but the learned counsel for the applicant has confined the relief only for a direction for enlargement of bail in terms of the law of the land.
